facts.fact: In Emmanuel Harunna v. NDPC (FHC/L/CS/1116/2024) Justice F.N. Ogazi examined sections 5(d), 6(c), 44, 45 and 65 of the Act and the NDPC cites Section 63 as prevailing over inconsistent law; the article gives no judgment date and is dated 28 July 2026.

Punch reports the NDPC, with National Commissioner and CEO Vincent Olatunji and Head of Legal, Enforcement and Regulations Babatunde Bamigboye, issued a statement on Tuesday 28 July 2026 directing unregistered Data Controllers and Processors of Major Importance to register.
